info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Proofs-v3-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Proofs API enables users to access comprehensive proof documentation related to various logistics shipments. This API provides functionality to retrieve detailed shipment proof records, allowing logistics managers and supply chain professionals to verify and validate shipments effectively. Typical consumers of this API include logistics companies, freight forwarders, and inventory managers who are looking to enhance their operational transparency and accountability. Users can utilize this API to efficiently track and audit shipment proofs, improving workflow efficiency and decision-making processes.

get.description: Fetches details related to the proof of shipment for a specific shipment ID, allowing users to verify shipment documentation and status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send the necessary information required to retrieve proof of shipments. Ensure that the data provided conforms to the expected schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the proof of shipment.

ListLogisticsShipmentsProofsRequest.description: Request body schema for retrieving shipment proof information. This schema accepts a string input that represents the request body.

ListLogisticsShipmentsProofsResponse_200.title: Shipment Proof Response
